decision.note: This fixture does not represent any real Meta app, business, customer, asset, Suite4/Msg4 identity, grant, approval, or environment.

proofRequired: Redacted app type, owning/claiming business reference, app mode, exact login configurations, callback origins, Graph API version and Embedded Signup version for the candidate.
Change history or approved config export bound to the candidate SHA; no app ID or secret in this repository.
Operation-to-permission/feature mapping separately for all five auth variants; request only capabilities currently used.
Current App Dashboard access level and per-permission/feature status; distinguish Standard from Advanced Access.
Redacted grant observation from a non-role test user where Advanced Access is required; do not treat app-level access as a customer grant.
Per-permission/feature App Review result, submission revision, any reviewer conditions, and matching test walkthrough for each released capability.
App Live mode or a developer/admin/tester login alone is not acceptance evidence.
Current verification result for the app-owning business and evidence that the exact app remains attached to that business.
Redacted status/date only; submitted company documents remain in Meta's restricted process.

applicationLevelGates.conditionalApplicability: Coexistence requires Solution Partner or Tech Provider per current Meta documentation. Tech Provider access verification is also independent of App Review for the applicable business-owned app permissions.
proofRequired: Current access-verification/partner status for the provider business, app attachment, permission applicability and restriction check.
Do not present this provider status as customer asset permission, business verification for each customer, or App Review approval.
Current data-handling submissions and Data Use Checkup state when applicable, plus approved purposes/processors and user-data handling answers.
Product/privacy approval of purpose, consent, retention, deletion and customer notice per flow.

requiredEvidence: Exact configured permissions/features mapped to Page discovery and each shipped Page operation.
App Review/access result and current non-role customer grant; do not infer a Page permission from tasks, target IDs, or another product flow.
Authorized non-role test identity completes the exact Facebook Login for Business configuration.
Sanitized granted permissions, consent time, current Page role/task observation, and revoke/reauthorize outcome.
Page is returned by provider-authorized discovery, selected explicitly, and bound to the same current tenant, app, environment and authorization.
Operation-specific Page task/grant is verified; Page task is not treated as a permission.
Current Page subscription endpoint/fields and callback behavior are separately proven before any webhook-dependent capability is released.
One authorized test Page covers selected operation, partial grant, empty Page list, expiry/revoke, subscription and webhook result, safe recovery, and redacted support trace.
Unsupported comments, messages or other capabilities remain off until their own operation-to-permission and provider behavior are approved.
Separate Facebook Login config, Facebook User token family and exact IG-operation permission map.
Reconcile each shipped operation with current Meta requirements; never copy Instagram Login scopes into this variant.
Authorized non-role test identity grants this exact Facebook Login variant and its operation-specific permissions.
Sanitized consent, scopes, current grant and revoke/reauthorize observation.
Instagram Business/Creator account is eligible and linked to the selected Page.
Instagram-to-Page relation and both assets belong to the same tenant, app, environment and authorization.
Grant covers the exact operation; test subscription/webhook behavior independently.
Non-role test identity proves account/Page discovery, only approved feature behavior, partial permission, missing Page relation, revoke/expiry, webhook and safe recovery.
Messages, comments or publishing stay blocked unless separately approved and implemented for this variant.
Separate Instagram Login configuration, graph.instagram.com host/token family and exact feature-to-scope map using current scope names.
Record app-level approval per requested scope; do not inherit Facebook Login/Page permissions.
Authorized non-role test user grants the exact direct Instagram Login variant for an eligible professional account.
Sanitized scopes, consent time, current grant and revoke/reauthorize observation.
Business/Creator account is confirmed through provider-authorized discovery and bound to the exact current authorization.
No Facebook Page relation is required or synthesized for this direct variant.
Verify subscription/webhook and only the approved operations.
Non-role test identity proves direct login, selected account, permission denial, revoke/expiry, webhook and safe recovery without a Page lookup.
Document the direct-login feature limits that apply to the release.
Exact Facebook Login for Business Embedded Signup configuration, current selected Cloud API product, Embedded Signup/Graph versions and allowed HTTPS callback origins.
Current configured scope names, Advanced Access/App Review result, webhook topics and operation-to-scope map for messaging/management features actually shipped.
Authorized customer business admin completes standard Cloud API onboarding and grants this app access to selected WhatsApp/Messaging account and phone.
Sanitized consent, account/phone grant, phone verification/registration state and revoke/reauthorize outcome; never store token, code or PIN.
Account and phone ownership/relationship are confirmed server-side for the same customer, tenant and authorization.
Verify current grant covers each operation and confirm phone eligibility and registration requirement from provider state.
Business verification/health/payment or other customer-account state is checked only where the exact Meta product/operation requires it; do not substitute provider-business verification.

Isolated authorized test account covers server-side code exchange, discovery, explicit selection, required registration without blind retries, webhook subscription and receipt, approved message/template path, revoke and recovery.
Message behavior uses a dedicated consenting test contact and a separately approved test plan; no send is authorized by this fixture.
Current Tech Provider or Solution Partner eligibility plus a separate Embedded Signup configuration and exact current version/session-info/webhook contract.
Current scope names, Advanced Access/App Review status and operation-to-scope map; do not transfer exclusive WhatsApp registration permissions or steps.
Authorized customer controls the existing WhatsApp Business App number, grants this provider access through the Coexistence path and makes an explicit history-sharing choice.
Record app version/eligibility observation, consent choice/time and revoke/reauthorize result as redacted references; do not store QR, code or token.
Exact current-version session result and server-side observation prove the Business App phone/account relation for the same customer, tenant and authorization.
Confirm customer number and partner/account eligibility plus callback/webhook subscription; browser event or QR completion is not readiness.
No conventional /register, deregister, delete or number replacement on the Coexistence path.
One authorized test number covers Business App and API behavior, inbound/outbound echoes, webhooks, explicit history consent/refusal, revoke and support escalation.
Document version-specific session fields and limitations before testing; confirm the M4.05 adapter has a reviewed current provider contract and remains blocked until then.

proofRequired: Joint walkthrough using a real authorized non-admin/tester identity and company; bind identity, membership, tenant, app and candidate SHA.
Issuer/audience/claims, key rotation, expiry, replay, current membership, membership revocation and tenant switching fail-closed evidence.
Embedded and standalone origin/return, browser session, Msg4 request/response/readiness semantics, callback handling and consumer outcome.
Redacted diagnostic bundle and named Suite4/Msg4 owner sign-off; no assertion from mocks or a Suite4-looking UUID.
Per-flow purpose/data map, data minimization, processor list, retention/deletion schedule and customer-facing notice approved by product/privacy/legal.
Separate consent to import Coexistence history, with timestamp/scope/refusal handling and current retention policy.
Applicable Meta Data Handling Questions, Data Use Checkup and deletion/callback status documented without putting personal data in the repository.

supportScenarios: customer reauthorization, missing permission or asset role
Meta app review, business verification, Tech Provider or eligibility block
expired/revoked grant or ambiguous provider response
webhook signature, subscription or consumer mismatch
Coexistence history consent/refusal or unsupported app behavior
Suite4 membership revocation, tenant mismatch or embed failure
operations.requiredExercise: Sanitized synthetic support ticket with correct internal/customer/Meta/Suite4 escalation and no raw token or SQL/Graph shortcut.
